title: Env.float misparses scientific notation
author: jakezwang

title: Make sure client reports report correct quantities
author: sentrivana
body_preview: Especially in case of transport errors (e.g. the `send_error` outcome), we might currently not be counting the number of dropped items correctly.  Check our client reports implementation for spans, metrics and logs and ensure the quantity reported is the actual number of spans/metrics/logs contained in the envelope that was dropped.
